purpose: Operational, auditable one-shot control for the sealed BLIND runtime recovery; it is not a claim of adversarially irreversible execution.

protected_against: operator resume of an unregistered LSF job
loss of the required scheduler and release audit trail
not_protected_against: a same-account adversary who can delete or recreate state
scheduler history retention outside the documented observation window
threat_model.claim_boundary: This protocol provides operational one-shot discipline and audit evidence only. It does not claim cryptographic or adversarial irreversibility for a same-user environment.

transition_rules.FROZEN_to_REGISTERED_HELD: Submit exactly one held, non-array LSF job and record its scheduler-assigned job id plus every frozen registration field before any resume.
transition_rules.REGISTERED_HELD_to_REVIEW_PASS: An independent PASS receipt binds the exact registered job id, commit, protocol digest, gate snapshot digest, command, queue, resource request, cwd, stdout, and stderr paths; it must also state no_blind_parse=true and no_blind_output=true.
transition_rules.REVIEW_PASS_to_RESUMED_ONCE: Only bresume of the preregistered job id is allowed. bsub, bmod, rerun, requeue, retry, array submission, and resume of any other id are forbidden.
transition_rules.RESUMED_ONCE_to_CONSUMED: The execution writes CONSUMED before parsing BLIND inputs. Any non-release outcome remains consumed and is not retried.
transition_rules.CONSUMED_to_RELEASED_VERIFIED: Release only after the canonical four-artifact audit passes and scheduler evidence is captured within HIST_HOURS.

registration.job_id_rule: No real job id is embedded in this frozen protocol. At REGISTERED_HELD the scheduler-assigned id becomes immutable and must be copied byte-exactly into the registration record and independent PASS receipt.

execution_and_audit.history_window_rule: HIST_HOURS=5 is an observed environment fact, not a guarantee. Capture bhist and bacct for the registered job id within five hours of resume; missing or late scheduler evidence fails RELEASED_VERIFIED.
